home.emptyState: No plays yet. Create your first!

landing.heroSubtitle: The free browser-based basketball tactics board for coaches and players. Draw plays, animate them step by step, and share via a link. No download or installation required.
landing.feature1Desc: Place offensive and defensive players on a full or half court. Choose from common formations like 5-Out, Horns, 2-3 Zone, or build a custom setup from scratch. Drag players anywhere on the court.
landing.feature2Desc: Add passes, dribbles, cuts, screens, handoffs, shots, and defensive movements. Each action becomes a step in the animation. Play it back to see the flow of the play at full speed.
landing.feature3Desc: Generate a shareable link with a single click. Send it to your team, assistant coaches, or players. No account needed to view — they open the link and watch the play.
landing.step1: Choose court type and set up your starting formation
landing.step2: Add actions — passes, cuts, screens, shots — step by step
landing.step3: Hit play to preview the animation, then share the link
landing.useCase1: Explain set plays to your team before a game
landing.useCase2: Break down opponent tendencies for scouting
landing.useCase3: Design out-of-bounds plays and baseline actions
landing.useCase4: Teach defensive rotations and help-side positioning
landing.useCase5: Share film-room concepts without video software
landing.freeTierNote: Free tier: up to 10 saved plays. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited saves, no ads, and video export.
